item.title: Brick by Brick: Kenai’s Russian Kiln — Part 2
item.description: AUTHOR’S NOTE: Other than some raw numbers, the history of brick making in colonial Alaska is poorly understood. Nevertheless, the Russian government in Alaska considered the manufacture of bricks highly important. During the 19th century, the Russian-American Company had kilns in at least nine different locations, including Kenai from 1841 to 1866.

item.title: Bryan Norcross: Atlantic likely to stay quiet as we look back at the incredible hurricane season 100 years ago
